advisories.statement: picomatch <=4.0.7 ReDoS on crafted extglob patterns; no fixed release exists. It reaches web/ and keycloak-theme/ only through build and test tooling (vite, vitest, tinyglobby, fdir, typescript-eslint), which match glob patterns written in this repository's config, never user input. It is not in the web production dependency tree (npm audit --omit=dev is clean) and is not bundled into the built web app or theme JAR.
